item.title: Bills aim to ban CO2 pipeline construction in these Louisiana lakes, wildlife management areas
item.description: Two Louisiana bills propose banning carbon dioxide pipeline construction in two lakes and certain wildlife management areas.

item.title: Investigation underway after suspected homemade explosives found in St. Mary Parish
item.description: The St. Mary Parish Sheriff's Office is investigating after deputies discovered several homemade explosive devices on Friday afternoon.

item.title: Supreme Court strikes down Trumps tariffs; local businesses say price relief may take time
item.description: A major Supreme Court ruling is reshaping the future of U.S. trade policy, striking down most of the broad tariffs imposed under former President Donald Trump. But for small business owners in Baton Rouge, the decision does not mean prices will suddenly fall.

item.title: Union Pacific responds to delays caused on LA 1 by stopped train
item.description: A stopped train recently caused headaches for drivers on LA 1. Union Pacific and West Baton Rouge Parish President Jason P. Manola weighed in on what happened Thursday morning.

item.title: Fifth Circuit Court rules public schools in Louisiana can display Ten Commandments
item.description: The U.S. Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that public schools in Louisiana can immediately start posting displays of the Ten Commandments on Friday, Feb. 20, vacating a preliminary injunction that had blocked the law.
